query: Configure VLAN 110 on L2 with SVI 10.110.2.1/24 and L2-H2 as an untagged member.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - VLAN-M-01
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:
    - name: Create VLAN 110 on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: sudo config vlan add 110
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify VLAN 110 Creation on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: show vlan config
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: vlan_creation_output
      failed_when: vlan_creation_output.rc != 0 or '110' not in vlan_creation_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Configure SVI IP 10.110.2.1/24 on VLAN 110 for SONiC-VS-2
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Vlan110 10.110.2.1/24
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify SVI IP Configuration on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: ip_intf_output
      failed_when: ip_intf_output.rc != 0 or 'Vlan110' not in ip_intf_output.stdout or '10.110.2.1/24' not in ip_intf_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Remove existing routed IP from Ethernet0 on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: sudo config interface ip remove Ethernet0 10.0.0.0/31
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify Ethernet0 no longer has a routed IP on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: eth0_ip_output
      failed_when: eth0_ip_output.rc != 0 or '10.0.0.0/31' in eth0_ip_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Add Ethernet0 to VLAN 110 as untagged on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: sudo config vlan member add 110 Ethernet0 -u
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify VLAN 110 Member Configuration on SONiC-VS-2
      raw: show vlan config
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: vlan_member_output
      failed_when: >
        vlan_member_output.rc != 0
        or '110' not in vlan_member_output.stdout
        or 'Ethernet0' not in vlan_member_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Save SONiC-VS-2 configuration
      raw: sudo config save -y
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify SONiC-VS-2 configuration was saved
      raw: sudo grep -c 'Vlan110' /etc/sonic/config_db.json
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: save_output
      failed_when: save_output.rc != 0 or save_output.stdout | trim == '0'
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ping SVI 10.110.2.1 from AlpineLinux-2 (H2)
      raw: ping -c 3 -W 2 10.110.2.1
      when: inventory_hostname == "AlpineLinux-2"
      register: ping_output
      failed_when: ping_output.rc != 0 or '0% packet loss' not in ping_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Final VLAN Configuration
      debug:
        var: vlan_member_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
